title: Papex Submission Manifest (papex.json)
description: Manifest shipped inside a papex source archive (tar.gz). It mirrors the papex database row model (papers / paper_versions / authors / citations) and adds LaTeX-build-specific fields (sections, references, build options). The 'paper hosting' backend reads this file to create a submission; the XeLaTeX toolchain reads it to auto-fill metadata and assemble the document.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the papex.json contract. Current: 1.0.0

$schema.description: Optional $schema pointer (ignored by the backend; used by editors).

paper.description: Core metadata. Maps onto papers + paper_versions rows.

id.description: Functional paper id (YYMM.NNNNN). Optional. If it matches an existing paper owned by the submitter, the upload is treated as a NEW VERSION of that paper; otherwise it is ignored and the platform assigns a fresh id.

title.description: Paper title. Becomes papers.title and paper_versions.title.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle rendered under the title.

keywords.description: Keywords / index terms printed after the abstract.

primaryCategoryId.description: Primary category code, e.g. 'cs.LG'. MUST exist in the categories table. Becomes papers.primaryCategoryId.

secondaryCategoryIds.description: Additional category codes. Becomes paper_categories rows (is_primary=false).

license.description: License identifier. Defaults to 'CC-BY-4.0'. Becomes paper_versions.license.

version.description: Informational version number (the platform still assigns its own latest_version).

versionNote.description: Version note, e.g. 'v2: camera-ready'. Becomes paper_versions.comments.

language.description: Primary language hint. 'auto' lets the toolchain detect CJK automatically.

subject.description: Optional one-line subject used in listing cards.

authors.description: Author list. Order is taken from the explicit 'order' field, falling back to array position. Becomes paper_authors + authors rows.

affiliation.description: Free-text affiliation line. Rendered as an authblk affiliation block.

order.description: Author order (0-based). Defaults to position in the array.

corresponding.description: Mark as corresponding author (footnote + contact line).

equalContribution.description: Mark as equal contribution (shared footnote marker).

footnote.description: Optional free-text author note appended to the author's footnote.

references.description: Bibliography entries. Either provide this array (the toolchain generates references.bib) OR ship a references.bib file in the archive (preferred if you need fine control). Becomes citation rows in the reference graph.

key.description: BibTeX citation key, e.g. 'vaswani2017'. Used as \cite{key} in sections.

author.description: BibTeX author list, e.g. 'Vaswani, A. and Shazeer, N. and Parmar, N.'

doi.description: DOI of the cited work -> citations.target_doi (used to resolve the internal citation graph).

url.description: URL of the cited work -> citations.target_url.

arxivId.description: arXiv id of the cited work -> citations.target_arxiv_id (used to resolve the internal citation graph).

sections.description: Ordered body structure. Each entry points to a .tex file (relative to the archive root) containing the section's LaTeX source. The toolchain \input{}s them in order.

id.description: Stable id (used for labels / TOC anchors).

title.description: Section heading. If omitted, the .tex file is expected to start with its own \section{...}.

file.description: Path to the section source, relative to the archive root, e.g. 'sections/intro.tex'.

level.description: Heading level used when 'title' is provided.

appendices.description: Optional appendices, emitted after the bibliography under a \appendix block.

acknowledgments.description: Acknowledgments paragraph (rendered as an unnumbered section before the bibliography).

documentclass.description: Document class to load. The official class is 'papex' (papex.cls).

mainFont.description: Override Latin main font (fontspec family name).

cjkFont.description: Override CJK main font (fontspec family name, used by \setCJKmainfont).
